paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah:
heading: Muvanlaite Leh Grepgui Gentehna
english: Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Mihing tapa, Israel inkote kiang ah thuhaksa bawlkhia inla, gentehna in gen in,
english: “Son of man, tell a riddle, and speak a parable to the house of Israel;

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi, chi in; Muvanlai lianpi, kha zapi, khaveng saupi gial em-um, mul bittak Lebanon tang ah aleng a, sidar sing zik atuah hi.
english: and say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “A great eagle with great wings and long feathers, full of feathers which had various colors, came to Lebanon and took the top of the cedar.

paite: Ahiang ziknou pen akitan a, mi vialvakna gam ah alenpih a, sumsinna khopi ah aphut hi.
english: He cropped off the topmost of its young twigs, and carried it to a land of traffic. He planted it in a city of merchants.

paite: Huai gam haichi leng atuah a, lei hoih ah apawipou a, tui tampi gei ah aphut a, muisum sing bang in aphut hi.
english: “‘“He also took some of the seed of the land and planted it in fruitful soil. He placed it beside many waters. He set it as a willow tree.

paite: Huan akhang a, grepgui niam bilbial ahong hi a, selnoute ahon suah a, ahiangte ahong dawn hi.
english: It grew and became a spreading vine of low stature, whose branches turned toward him, and its roots were under him. So it became a vine, produced branches, and shot out sprigs.

paite: "Muvanlai lianpi dang a-om nawn a, kha zapi leh mul bittak anei a, ngai in, hiai grep kung amah lam ah azung azam a; asuanna mun a kipan in amah lam ah hiangte apoukhia a, amah tui a avaktheihna ding in.
english: “‘“There was also another great eagle with great wings and many feathers. Behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and shot out its branches toward him, from the ground where it was planted, that he might water it.

paite: Hiangte asuah a, grep hoihtak ahihtheihna ding in tui tampi gei a lei hoih aphuh ahi."
english: It was planted in a good soil by many waters, that it might produce branches and that it might bear fruit, that it might be a good vine.”’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Apiching den dia hia? Avuai maimah theihna ding in anahte satkhia in, azung toh abotkhe kei dia hia? Anah sel thak tengteng in leng avuailoh ding; azung toh botkhe ding in thilhihtheihna thupitak hiam, muvanlai tampi akiphamoh tuan kei dia hia?
english: “Say, ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Will it prosper? Won’t he pull up its roots and cut off its fruit, that it may wither, that all its fresh springing leaves may wither? It can’t be raised from its roots by a strong arm or many people.

paite: "Ahi, ngai in, phuh hileh leng apiching den dia hia? Suahlam huih in ahon nuai hun chiang in avuai khin maimah kei dia hia? Apouna mun mah ah avuai maimah ding chi in," achi a.
english: Yes, behold, being planted, will it prosper? Won’t it utterly wither when the east wind touches it? It will wither in the ground where it grew.”’”

paite: TOUPA thu ka kiang ah ahong tung a, ka kiang ah:
heading: Gentehna Hilhchetna
english: Moreover Yahweh’s word came to me, saying,

paite: "Helhat inkote kiang ah gen in, hiai thil omdan athei kei ua hia? Hilh in, ngai un, Babulon kumpipa Jerusalem ah ahong pai a,
english: “Say now to the rebellious house, ‘Don’t you know what these things mean?’ Tell them, ‘Behold, the king of Babylon came to Jerusalem, and took its king, and its princes, and brought them to him to Babylon.

paite: akumpipa uleh aheutu uh aman a, amah kiang ah Babulon ah api a, akumpipa uh suan khat aman a, thukhun abawlpih a, thu achiam teitei a, gam a miliante apimang vek a,
english: He took one of the royal offspring, and made a covenant with him. He also brought him under an oath, and took away the mighty of the land,

paite: alalna gam akeniam a, amah a adinkhiak theih nawnlouhna ding in athukhun len kawm kia a adintheihna ding in.
english: that the kingdom might be brought low, that it might not lift itself up, but that by keeping his covenant it might stand.

paite: Himahleh sakolte leh mi tampi hon sawl ding a ngen ding in Aigupta gam a palai sawl in atung ah ahelta hi. Alohching ding hia? Hichibang hihmi asuakta ding hia? Thukhun hihse ngal in apawtkhe thou ding hia?"
english: But he rebelled against him in sending his ambassadors into Egypt, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does such things escape? Will he break the covenant, and still escape?

paite: Kei ka hin bang in, chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi; kumpipa, kumpipa dia bawlpa tenna ngei ah akichiamnate musit leh athukhunte bohsia a, amah kiang mahmah ah Babulon ah asi ding hi.
english: “‘As I live,’ says the Lord Yahweh, ‘surely in the place where the king dwells who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, even with him in the middle of Babylon he will die.

paite: Mi tampi hihlup ding a mual pawngte leh kulhte abawl hun chiang un leng Pharaoh sepaihhon leh pawl thupi mahmah leng bangmah ahihsak thei kei ding uh.
english: Pharaoh with his mighty army and great company won’t help him in the war, when they cast up mounds and build forts to cut off many persons.

paite: Thukhun bohsia in kichiamna amusitta ngal ua; thu akichiam nung in hiai thil tengteng ahih nawn a, asuakta peuhmah kei ding hi.
english: For he has despised the oath by breaking the covenant; and behold, he had given his hand, and yet has done all these things. He won’t escape.

paite: Huaiziak in Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: ka kichiamna amusit a, ka thukhun abohsia a, kei ka hin bang in, ama tung ah ka bung ngeingei ding hi.
english: “Therefore the Lord Yahweh says: ‘As I live, I will surely bring on his own head my oath that he has despised and my covenant that he has broken.

paite: Len in ka khuh ding a, ka thang ah a-awk ding a, Babulon ah ka hon pi ding a, huchi in abohsiatna, ka tung ngei a abohsiatnate ziak in amah ka sual ding.
english: I will spread my net on him, and he will be taken in my snare. I will bring him to Babylon, and will enter into judgment with him there for his trespass that he has trespassed against me.

paite: Huan apawl tengteng a taikekte tengteng namsau in asi ding ua, a-omlaite kawlmong chih ah adalh ding uh; huan kei TOUPA'N ka genta chih atheikhe ding uh.
english: All his fugitives in all his bands will fall by the sword, and those who remain will be scattered toward every wind. Then you will know that I, Yahweh, have spoken it.’

paite: Toupa PATHIAN in hichi in achi: "Sidar sang mahmah dawn ke'n ka la ding a, ka phut ding; azikpi pen aziknou ka khiak ding a, tang sang kidoh ah ka phut ding.
heading: Pathian Lametna Thuchiam
english: “The Lord Yahweh says: ‘I will also take some of the lofty top of the cedar, and will plant it. I will crop off from the topmost of its young twigs a tender one, and I will plant it on a high and lofty mountain.

paite: Israel sanna tang ah ka phut ding a, hiangte ahong sel ding ua, ahong gah ding, sidar thupitak ahi ding; anuai ah tungleng vasa chi chih ateng ding ua, ahiang liimte ah a-om ding uh.
english: I will plant it in the mountain of the height of Israel; and it will produce boughs, and bear fruit, and be a good cedar. Birds of every kind will dwell in the shade of its branches.

paite: Huan gam sing tengteng in kei TOUPA'N sing sangte ka niamsak a, sing niamte ka sangsak a, sing hingte ka keusak a, sing keute ka hingphasak a, ka chi nalai hi,” achi hi. Kei TOUPA'N ka genta a, ka gen bang in ka hih ding hi.
english: All the trees of the field will know that I, Yahweh, have brought down the high tree, have exalted the low tree, have dried up the green tree, and have made the dry tree flourish. “‘I, Yahweh, have spoken and have done it.’”
